svg.title: GuitarDAWLiteOS codec and power sheet
svg.desc: Pi 5 J8 header, PCM1808 ADC, and GY-PCM5102 DAC with every pin assigned to a net, decoupling, strapping, and power. Nets joined by name.
svg.text: p2 = +5Vp1 = +3V3p6 = GNDp7 GPIO4 -> MCLKp12 GPIO18 -> BCLKp35 GPIO19 -> LRCLKp38 GPIO20 <- CAPDATp40 GPIO21 -> PLAYDAT

1 VREF . dec 0.1uF+10uF2 AGND . GND3 VCC . +5V (via FB1)4 VDD . +3V35 DGND . GND6 SCKI <- MCLK7 LRCK <- LRCLK8 BCK <- BCLK9 DOUT -> CAPDAT10 MD0 . GND11 MD1 . GND12 FMT . GND13 VINL <- front-end (U1)14 VINR <- Cr 1uF -> AGND
VIN . +5VGND . GNDSCK . GND (int PLL)BCK <- BCLKLCK <- LRCLKDIN <- PLAYDATFLT/DEMP/FMT pad . LXSMT pad . H (+3V3)OUT L/R/G -> line out
Nets joined by name: +5V . +3V3 . GND . MCLK . BCLK . LRCLK . CAPDAT . PLAYDAT.
Decoupling 0.1uF+10uF at U2 VCC, VDD, VREF (to AGND). FB1 = ferrite on +5V to U2 VCC.
AGND = DGND, single star to one Pi GND. U3 module self-decoupled; output RC 470ohm + 2.2nF/ch.
